newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia anthrax outbreak still spreading.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia anthrax outbreak still spreading.

text.p: The anthrax outbreak in the Australian state of Victoria has continued to spread, with more cattle deaths and infected properties.
A spokesman for the Department of Natural Resources and Environment told Reuters on Tuesday that a total of 121 cattle had died from the disease, up from 105 on Monday.
The number of infected properties in the Tatura-Stanhope region of northern Victoria had risen to 61, up from 52 on Monday.
A total of 26,000 cattle had now been vaccinated on more than 200 properties, up from 21,000 cattle vaccinated on Monday.

Australian authorities have said that anthrax, a disease which causes rapid death in cattle, sheep and goats and is caught through the consumption of contaminated material, poses no threat to consumers of Australian dairy products.
The outbreak is the worst in the history of Victoria, which supplies about half of Australia's dairy products. The infected area supplies about 30 percent of Australia's dairy products.
